sources: President Donald Trump, 20-minute phone interview with CNN's Jim Sciutto, Sunday Nov 8 2026
fault_line: Deal or bluff? Trump says war is 'highly unlikely' -- but names 38 bridges he can drop in an hour. Is he negotiating, or loading the threat?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Trump said renewed US strikes on Iran are 'highly unlikely' if negotiations progress on Tehran's nuclear programme and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, repeating the assertion five times; conditional on Iran signing 'a very strong agreement'. Also on record: 'We're ready for it. I've got three aircraft carriers here... fully locked and loaded'; the US has identified infrastructure targets including power plants and '38 bridges in our site that we can knock down in literally one hour'; Iran's air defences are 'gone'; Iran keeps '10% of its missile capacity and 15% of its drone capabilities'; Iran inflation '301% this year'.
sections.what_verified: CNN interview is the primary record (no declared tier -- attribution only, never counts toward the gate); Jerusalem Post T3 independently carries the quotes; Mezha (no declared tier) also carries them. Tiered families: 1 (Jerusalem Post T3). Gate met via the primary-source exception: the claim IS the actor's own on-record statement.
sections.what_disputed: Iran's stated position (SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei, Nov 5-7, via Kremlin readout + Iranian state media): no Hormuz opening and no negotiations until Iran's seven conditions are met -- directly contradicts Trump's 'They want to make a deal so badly'. Katz (Nov 8, via AFP/FMT): 'the mission is still not complete', new strikes threatened. Fox News (via israelrealtime Substack, Nov 8): senior US officials identified Nov 9 as a potentially favourable strike date (new moon) -- unconfirmed, single T4 source. NBC (Nov 7): officials warned Trump the window for another campaign narrows within ~8 weeks before the new Democratic Congress sits Jan 3. Trump's own mixed messages: Nov 5 'maybe I'll have to [destroy the rest]... you'll know soon enough' vs Nov 8 'highly unlikely'.
sections.why_matters: Trump says NO new war with Iran -- 'highly unlikely' -- then names the 38 bridges he can knock down in one hour. Deal, or the threat before the deal?
